note: Contrast inventory for D3. Measures obligation diversity in a homogeneous tokenized vault standard.

obligations.statement: totalAssets must return total underlying assets managed by vault without reverting.
convertToShares must not revert, must round down towards zero, and must equal previewDeposit if no fees apply.
convertToAssets must not revert, must round down towards zero, and must equal previewRedeem if no fees apply.
maxDeposit must return 0 if deposits are paused or receiver cannot receive shares; must return type(uint256).max if uncapped.
previewDeposit must round down (shares issued) to protect the vault against share inflation.
deposit must emit Deposit event and transfer exact assets from caller, minting previewDeposit amount.
maxMint must return 0 if minting is paused; must return maximum shares that can be minted.
previewMint must round up (assets required) to protect the vault against share dilution.
maxWithdraw must return maximum assets withdrawable by owner considering balance and allowance.
previewWithdraw must round up (shares burned) to prevent vault dilution during asset withdrawal.
withdraw must burn shares from owner, transfer assets to receiver, and check allowance if msg.sender != owner.
maxRedeem must return maximum shares redeemable by owner considering balance and allowance.
previewRedeem must round down (assets delivered) to prevent vault dilution during redemption.
First-depositor inflation defense (virtual shares/assets or dead share burn) must prevent donation/inflation attacks.
Vault must guard against fee-on-transfer tokens by measuring actual received balance delta rather than nominal amount.
